title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 16 日

stories.headline_en: Taiwan's Economic Outlook Brightens with Strong Growth Forecast
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣經濟前景看好，成長預測強勁

sentences.en: Taiwan's economic forecast for 2026 has been raised to 12.16%.
sentences.zh: 臺灣 2026 年的經濟預測已上調至 12.16%。

sentences.en: This is the highest growth rate seen in nearly four decades.
sentences.zh: 這是近四十年來最高的成長率。

sentences.en: The Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research announced this update.
sentences.zh: 中華經濟研究院公布了這項更新。

sentences.en: Strong global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) drives this expansion.
sentences.zh: 全球對人工智慧的強勁需求推動了這項擴張。

sentences.en: However, inflationary pressures from energy prices remain a concern.
sentences.zh: 然而，能源價格帶來的通膨壓力仍令人擔憂。

stories.headline_en: China Proposes AI Cooperation with US Ahead of APEC Summit
stories.headline_zh: 中國在亞太經合會前夕提議與美國進行人工智慧合作

sentences.en: China has made a diplomatic move for AI cooperation with the US.
sentences.zh: 中國已提出與美國在人工智慧領域進行外交合作的建議。

sentences.en: This comes before the APEC Summit in Shenzhen.
sentences.zh: 這項提議是在深圳亞太經合會前夕提出的。

sentences.en: It could ease tech tensions between the two nations.
sentences.zh: 這可能緩解兩國之間的科技緊張關係。

sentences.en: The plan includes research and safety standards.
sentences.zh: 該計畫包含研究與安全標準。

sentences.en: Global leaders will discuss AI governance at the upcoming forum.
sentences.zh: 全球領袖將在即將舉行的論壇上討論人工智慧治理。

stories.headline_en: US Air Travel Recovers After Major Nationwide Ground Stop
stories.headline_zh: 美國空中交通在全國停飛後恢復正常

sentences.en: US air travel is recovering after widespread disruptions.
sentences.zh: 美國空中交通在廣泛中斷後正在恢復。

sentences.en: A nationwide ground stop left thousands of passengers stranded.
sentences.zh: 全國性的停飛導致數千名旅客滯留。

sentences.en: This was the longest such ground stop in twenty-five years.
sentences.zh: 這是二十五年來最長的一次停飛。

sentences.en: Antiquated equipment and new technology overload were blamed.
sentences.zh: 老舊設備和新科技超載是造成問題的原因。

sentences.en: Airlines worked to minimize delays and cancellations.
sentences.zh: 航空公司努力將延誤和取消降到最低。
